destinations.description: List of DHCP server addresses to which DHCP requests will be relayed. Each entry must be a valid IP address or resolvable hostname.

interfaces.description: List of network interface names (e.g., eth0, br0) on which to listen for DHCP DISCOVER/OFFER/REQUEST/ACK messages.

options.description: Additional command-line options passed to the dhcp-helper daemon (e.g., `-d` for debug mode, `-f` to run in foreground). Leave empty for defaults.
